changelog: Reliable 3D comparison: completed builds stay recoverable, exact diffing is bounded and observable, difficult CAD gets a labeled approximate fallback, and the default agent interface is build123d-first.
summary: CAD tool for AI agents. Use when the user asks you to design, model, or build a 3D object. agentcad executes build123d Python scripts and produces STEP files, PNG renders, mesh exports (STL/GLB/OBJ), and geometric metrics.
